feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Supreme Court blocks Republican redistricting attempt in Missouri
entry.summary: The Supreme Court rejects a Republican attempt to redistrict the congressional seats in Missouri.

entry.title: With primaries over, some members of the GOP are breaking with President Trump
entry.summary: Several Republicans in competitive races broke with President Trump on key agenda issues this week as voters continue to express concern about the economy and the war with Iran.

entry.title: Africa wrestles with increasing deaths from non-communicable diseases
entry.summary: A new study from the Lancet out this week finds that non-communicable diseases accounted for nearly 5 million deaths across Africa in 2023, representing 45% of all deaths in Africa.

entry.title: Leon Bridges' new album 'Happiness Anytime' is about cultivating joy
entry.summary: On his new album, Leon Bridges teams up with members of the band Jungle, frees himself of genre constraints and creates music that cultivates joy.

entry.title: Soybean farmers hopeful for Xi's White House visit
entry.summary: As China's president visits the White House, the Asia Society is visiting South Dakota to get grassroots views on agriculture trade issues.

entry.title: 'Acting is doing': Willem Dafoe on what people get wrong about acting
entry.summary: Willem Dafoe's desire to challenge himself has made the 71-year-old very productive. He's in five films being released in the second half of this year. That includes his most recent film, Late Fame.

entry.title: How Micah Johnson went Major League Baseball player to fine artist
entry.summary: Talent and a special kind of passion landed Micah Johnson in Major League Baseball. When a mental health crisis pushed him out of the sport, he turned his drive to another field entirely: fine art.

entry.title: How unarmed 911 teams are reshaping public safety in nearly 100 cities
entry.summary: Programs that send mental health workers out to 911 calls instead of police have grown in recent years. But doing them right is a challenge.

entry.title: Nashville celebrates Dolly Parton on 9/25 in a nod to '9 to 5'
entry.summary: It's Sept. 25, and in a nod to "9 to 5", people in Nashville and other places are celebrating the Queen of Country, Dolly Party.

entry.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
entry.summary: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.
